name: Intake Agent
description: Intercepts raw conversational marketing directives. Employs Gemini 3.5 Flash to parse semantic category bounds, flight timelines, and specific division criteria.
inputs: Raw text brief from brand manager, client context headers
dataNeeded: Retail beverage & soft drink divisions dictionary

name: Feasibility Agent
description: Calculates feasibility limits and contact boundaries. Evaluates Rolling week cap rules and prevents high shopper frequency overlaps.

name: Prioritization Agent
description: Resolves priority overlaps when multiple campaign concepts clash. Evaluates Super Admin weights and loyalty multipliers.
inputs: Estimated cohort stats, prioritization rules weights
outputs: Ranked campaign schedule, adjusted priority scores

name: Research Agent
description: Performs real-time search grounding to validate proposed campaigns. Benchmarks pricing and concepts against seasonal beverage retail catalogs, CPG market indices, and flavor trend indicators.
inputs: Theme objectives, target items, competitor exclusion briefs
outputs: Market validation logs, trend alignment scores

name: Creative Gen Agent
description: Assembles display banners and marketing copy templates. Triggers Vertex AI Image Generation for WebP banner files and saves them to GCS.
inputs: Approved concept specs, tone options (e.g. Friendly, Savings-oriented)
outputs: WebP Banners (GCS URL references) + Display copies

name: Validation Agent
description: Reviews all generated copies and display layouts. Compares text strings and image attributes against legal rules, trademark lists, and competitive exclusions.
inputs: Draft banner images, copy variations, brand guidelines
outputs: Compliance checklist report, trademark match triggers

name: Integration Agent
description: Validates double supervisor electronic signatures, seals finalized payloads, and delivers verified packages directly to marketing channel routers.
inputs: Completed campaign assets + verified manager signoff keys
outputs: Signed outbound REST payload transfer packet

name: Model Agent
description: Monitors campaign performance analytics. Identifies conversion prediction drops to automatically recommend and cue new custom models on top of BigQuery data.
inputs: Historical conversion logs, data requests frequency, prediction errors
outputs: Machine learning model recommendations, training queue triggers

name: Judge Agent
description: Examines final campaign strategy, creatives, feasibility, and compliance to identify gaps, pros/cons, and analytics insights.
inputs: Cumulative preceding agent inputs, logs, and artifacts
